title: Peak XV, which split from Sequoia in 2023, raised $1.3B across new India- and Asia-focused funds, bringing its total assets under management to over $10B (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Peak XV, which split from Sequoia in 2023, raised $1.3B across new India- and Asia-focused funds, bringing its total assets under management to over $10B — Peak XV announced on Friday that it has raised $1.3 billion across new India and Asia-focused funds.
